escena: SCENE (a café in Santiago, late morning, the AI agent has just booked a meeting on a website for her): a woman's right hand holds a current flagship smartphone with thin even bezels, tilted toward the camera at chest height above a dark walnut café table; caught at the exact moment the assistant's confirmation lands, her thumb lifts off the glass. The phone screen is the brightest object in the frame and is the subject: a clean light-mode chat with an AI assistant, her short question bubble on the right, and below it the assistant's answer as a large confirmation card with a big blue check circle, a calendar block reading as a day and a time, and a solid blue button; the small words on the screen are too small to read, only the structure of a confirmed booking reads at a glance. A flat white cup with a little espresso foam sits out of focus behind the phone. Hard late-morning sun from a window at the left rakes across the hand and the table, one side of the fingers lit, the other in open shade; the café behind falls into soft dark blur with one cool window highlight high on the left. No laptop, no paper, no menu, nothing analog in focus. The phone and the hand sit in the upper middle of the frame, centred horizontally, filling about half the frame width. the screen throws a cool blue glow onto her fingertips and carries the brand blue in its check and button; one small orange accent: the woman's thin orange watch strap. 85mm lens at f/2, focus on the screen.

lecho.objeto: the near edge of the dark walnut café table, out of focus
